## Private media cleanup endpoint
`POST /webhook/delete-media-drive-files`

**Authentication:** Header Auth credential `VP Media Delete Webhook`

**Body:**
```json
{ "file_ids": ["transcript-file-id", "summary-file-id"] }
```

Uses the existing `Google Drive account` OAuth credential. Files are moved to Drive Trash, not permanently erased. The workflow retries transient Drive failures and only returns `{ ok: true }` after every requested file succeeds.

parameters.jsCode:
const fileIds = $('Validate Delete Request').all().map(item => item.json.file_id);
return [{ json: { ok: true, trashed: fileIds.length } }];
